payload.docs: Emitted-as-projection and read back against the shipped surface: the boot handover shows i8-phone-lane at finalize_docs with its green verify; the board runs the phone lane when configured (verified the wiring does not disturb the board test). The phone lane's how-to lives WHERE it is taught - se.guidance-phone-setup (config shape, pairing, accepted-risk note, owner-physical verify), registry-served. The inherited v1 phone ADRs now describe REALIZED code, not just a decision. Honest absences unchanged: the BOOK emitter is i6's job; the live from-away pairing is the owner-physical RAID. No doc teaches a superseded way.
